newsitem.title: CANADA: Indonesia initials Int'l Pursuit contracts.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia initials Int'l Pursuit contracts.

text.p: International Pursuit Corp said on Monday that Indonesia's director general of mines has initialed the majority of the company's contracts of work to continue mineral exploration in Central Kalimantan.
The contracts of work will now be passed to a parliamentary committee for final ratification, the company said in a statement.
Pursuit also said that the Indonesian government has returned US$20 million plus interest of the company's deposit money. Another US$2 million is expected to be released in January.
The company said it has direct and indirect interests in five million hectares in Kalimantan.
Trading of Pursuit shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange was halted this morning. The shares closed at C$5.05 on Friday.
